name: web-spray-texture-agency-page-with-stats-and-case-carousel
title: White agency page with blue and pink spray-paint clouds, coloured stats and a tilted case carousel
whatItIs: A white page with soft spray-painted blue clouds, a stats row 'Numbers that speak' in blue, black and red, an 'Our cases' section with a lilac card carousel showing a fitness brand with images and blue arrows, and a pink spray panel with a large statement containing inline image and icon chips and a blue Apply button.
whatItMeans: Friendly and loose; spray texture and coloured numerals give warmth.
techniques: Tilt side cards in a carousel.
Embed icon chips inline in a statement.

vocabulary.definition: A small icon inside a sentence.
